cases.prompt: Discover a Seiche market and exact source-adapter partition, then request no more than twenty permitted canonical observations. Preserve source clocks, units and restrictions.
cases.expected_behavior: Copy market and source identifiers from discovery and use limit 20. Respect redistribution validation; report denial or missing coverage without reconstructing withheld values.
